gloss: to sleep soundly; to sleep deeply

definitions.gloss: to sleep soundly; to sleep deeply
definitions.explanation: To fall into a deep, uninterrupted, restful sleep. Implies high quality of sleep with no disturbances.

examples.japanese: {昨夜|ゆうべ}は{熟睡|じゅくすい}できた。
examples.english: I was able to sleep soundly last night.

examples.japanese: {赤|あか}ちゃんが{熟睡|じゅくすい}しているので、{静|しず}かにしてください。
examples.english: The baby is sleeping soundly, so please be quiet.

examples.japanese: {運動|うんどう}した{日|ひ}は{疲|つか}れて{熟睡|じゅくすい}できることが{多|おお}い。
examples.english: On days when I exercise, I'm often tired enough to sleep deeply.

notes:
Describes the ideal quality of sleep — deep and undisturbed. Commonly appears in health and lifestyle discussions about sleep quality.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {熟睡|じゅくすい}できる: to be able to sleep soundly
- {熟睡|じゅくすい}できない: unable to sleep deeply
- {熟睡|じゅくすい}のコツ: tips for sleeping soundly
- {熟睡|じゅくすい}{感|かん}: feeling of having slept deeply

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ぐっすり{眠|ねむ}る: to sleep soundly (colloquial) — more casual and conversational, while {熟睡|じゅくすい} is more formal and often used in written or medical contexts
- {爆睡|ばくすい}する: to crash out, to sleep like a log (informal) — emphasizes falling asleep suddenly and completely, often from exhaustion, with a more casual or humorous tone
- {安眠|あんみん}する: to sleep peacefully — emphasizes tranquility of sleep rather than depth
